verdict.rationale: Meta ships open weights through a documented self-serve download path: the llama-model CLI, signed-URL requests, and the meta-llama Hugging Face org with Hugging Face transformers-format checkpoints. The license covers commercial use, so the weights meet the 'tunable open weights' branch of the story. However, the pack contains no first-party fine-tuning guide, recipe or hosted fine-tuning API, and llama.com developer docs sit behind an SSO wall, so the fine-tuning step itself is only implied. Missing for 10: documented fine-tuning workflow or recipes, a hosted fine-tuning API, explicit license language on derivative fine-tunes, and hands-on corroboration of fine-tuning.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune the vendor's models on my own data through a documented self-serve path — hosted fine-tuning API or tunable open weights

citations.quote: In this organization, you can find models in both the original Meta format as well as the Hugging Face transformers format.
